				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>at the Beach Front</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>All you need is to enjoy your kitesurfing days</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span> Experience the turquoise waters of Paje, Zanzibar, in a fun, adrenaline-filled way. Enjoy the pure freedom of kitesurfing with one of Zanzibar’s most inclusive kiteschool.</span></p>
<p>We offer courses and lessons for beginners to advanced levels with our dedicated instructors and beginner-friendly equipment.</p>
<p>You brought your own gear? Our beach assistants will help you set up your kite and lines always with a smile. Check with the staff if there is availability to store your gear in the school for your next session.</p>
<p>The Kite spot is hot: at low tide, the knee-deep lagoon and its flat water make the perfect conditions for learning. Mid and high tides offer beautiful waves by the reef for experienced kite surfers. The water is always warm.</p>
<p>Hakuna Matata Kiteschool is located at the beachfront, just 70 meters away! </p></div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">Rent everything you need!</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_15  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p> Kite, bar, harness &amp; twintip board :<br />PER HOUR: $20<br />HALF DAY: $50<br />FULL DAY: $80<br />3 DAYS: $200<br />6 DAYS: $330</p>
<p><b>PLUS!</b> Our assistants will take care of everything, from setting up your gear, launching and landing your kite to watching you from the beach for your safety!</p>
<p>Kites: Airush and Cabrinha<br />Boards and harness: mixed brands</p></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>THE SCHOOL</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_17  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We started the school in 2018 on a different location and moved this year to our new prime spot just in front of the hotel. Yassin is still with us, now running the school with his brother Fais and the rest of the team.</p>
<p>For all questions regarding the lessons or rental, you can contact him directly by Whatsapp +255 772 680 056. See you on the water!</p></div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Winter: Kuzi</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_20  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>From May to October, the southern monsoon blows from south-east, 12-25 knots powered up with thermical wind. Note: the rainy season can last until June.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_15  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_21  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Summer: Kazkazi</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_22  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Early November to April, the northern monsoon blows from north-east, 10-20 knots. The wind season is from end December till end of February.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>
